say:0:1534401001:0.text: The mural is in ruins. The once-luxurious oils and gilding have long faded, leaving only crumbling flakes scattered across the floor.
say:0:1534401001:0.source_cn: 巨大的壁画残破不堪，旧日华贵的油膏与金箔早已磨损，化作...

say:1:1534401002:0.text: You study the three priests painted on the right. They kneel in reverence, worshipping the loving Father.
say:1:1534401002:0.source_cn: 你端详着壁画右侧的三位祭司。他们以朝圣的姿态虔诚地弯下...
say:1:1534401002:0.male: You study the three priests painted on the right. They kneel in reverence, worshipping the loving Father.
say:1:1534401002:0.female: You study the three priests painted on the right. They kneel in reverence, worshipping the loving Father.

say:2:1534401003:0.text: Then you notice something strange: one priest's garments look eerily familiar. You realize—it's him. That twisted humanoid you saw when you first entered.
say:2:1534401003:0.source_cn: 你忽然发现，其中一位祭司身上的服饰似乎有些眼熟。你回忆...
say:2:1534401003:0.male: Then you notice something strange: one priest's garments look eerily familiar. You realize—it's him. That twisted humanoid you saw when you first entered.
say:2:1534401003:0.female: Then you notice something strange: one priest's garments look eerily familiar. You realize—it's him. That twisted humanoid you saw when you first entered.

say:3:1534401004:0.text: He never even reached the altar for the ceremony before the god he worshipped, the God of Harvest, corrupted him.
say:3:1534401004:0.source_cn: ……是他。他甚至还没有来得及去祭坛参加仪式，就被曾经虔...
